description: This file defines a set data structure for strings, including functions for set operations such as insert, delete, union, intersection, difference, and checks for containment and equality. It is part of the internal utility package in a Kubernetes-related project.

methods.name: NewString
methods.description: Creates a String set from a list of string items.

methods.name: StringKeySet
methods.description: Creates a String set from the keys of a map, panics if input is not a map.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an item is in the set.

methods.name: HasAll
methods.description: Checks if all specified items are in the set.

methods.name: HasAny
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified items are in the set.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns a set of items in the receiver that are not in the argument set.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Returns a new set containing items in either set.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Returns a set of items common to both sets.

methods.name: IsSuperset
methods.description: Checks if the receiver set is a superset of the argument set.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two sets are equal.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns the set elements as a sorted slice of strings.

methods.name: UnsortedList
methods.description: Returns the set elements as an unsorted slice of strings.

methods.name: PopAny
methods.description: Removes and returns an arbitrary element from the set.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.
